evidence.title: Aero Lite is Live on Arc

why: Aero's article dated 2026-09-16: "Starting today, Aero Lite is live on Arc".

Earliest of the contracts on myarcade.fun/contracts: Prize Vault 0x13041baE3da3616E432314D3e0F562b87aF66E55 created in block 22254988 at 2026-09-22T23:27:42Z (Machine Manager one block later; $ARCADE token 2026-09-30). Read via rpc.mainnet.arc.io (explorer behind Cloudflare challenge).

Archery docs (archery.wtf/docs/security) give start block 22447642; the ARCHERY token 0x85799160a8f84a90b41ced026e2873e9025d973c was created in that block at 2026-09-24T02:37:11Z, V2/V3 factories seconds later. No earlier listed contract has code before it.
arcland.app only says "Launching with ARC Mainnet" (no date) and lists no contract addresses; X not readable. No dated source.

Arclight Builder V3 0x4685DF65C62b6B58376555694ada521DbD932732 (listed on arclight.finance/docs/contracts) created at 2026-09-16T20:10:59Z, Builder V4 10s later; changelog v1.0.0 = "Mainnet launch. V3 and V4 builders deployed" (undated).

astock.fi's embedded config names token ASTOCK 0x4c9b47dbd5933aa4574b2c27f82419e4dbbd0222; it was created at 2026-09-16T23:45:24Z by the config's deployer 0xfE661B…6D7c (via factory 0xb021…97da). Its v1 hub followed 2026-09-17T00:15:57Z and the config says deployment mode mainnet, deployedAt 2026-09-17T01:52:37Z.

Earliest of the entry's Arctide contracts: AMM factory 0x6afd30cb35d8b70cfd84c9aca92ddc2dda2879cb created 2026-09-16T05:22:00Z; router, Hardstake, LP locker, limit executor and TIDE token all followed the same day.

No dated launch statement found. The README's contracts were created 2026-09-09 (ArcRewardsVault v2) to 2026-09-24, earliest ones before the public mainnet launch (aggregator 2026-09-13, ArcPad 2026-09-11), so creation dates are not a live date. Treasury address has no code (EOA).

Release published 2026-09-16T18:48Z: LLMClient(api_url="https://arc.blockrun.ai/api") "pays on Circle's Arc" (eip155:5042), "Verified against arc.blockrun.ai". Also named in Circle's 2026-09-16 launch release/blog as an early Agent Stack service.
